subject: Coordinating equity settlement sprint + approval slots for upcoming offers
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Emily Chen <emily.chen@harborlaw.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Coordinating equity settlement sprint + approval slots for upcoming offers

Team —

We have a short offer close window for three roles at GreenPeak (senior eng, staff data scientist, and a principal infra hire) that we want to finalize this week. Comp is approved, but we need to align on:

- whether we can issue options from the existing pool or need board sign-off for a batch settlement;
- which 409A snapshot we'll use (current opinion memo attached); and
- slot availability on the board secretary calendar for signature (ideally this Thursday or Friday).

Attached: pro_rata_candidates_Q4.xlsx (names + offer details), option_agreement_v2.pdf (template), 409a-summary-Nov2026.pdf.

Specific asks:
1) Laura — can you confirm whether any of these hires require pre-board approval because of strike size / exceptional grants? If so, call out the names and suggested batch labeling.
2) Markus — if we need a board info packet, can you turn around the one-pager and cap table extract by EOD?
3) Marissa — please prepare the pro-rata sign-off and confirm whether we should keep the offers contingent on the next valuation cycle.

If we can get answers by 1pm PT I can coordinate with BoardSec and Emily (external counsel) to request a short signature slot.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, Emily Chen <emily.chen@harborlaw.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coordinating equity settlement sprint + approval slots for upcoming offers

Jonas —

Quick answers below after scanning the candidate list:

- Senior Eng (GreenPeak) — standard hire, <1% target over 4 years. Can be issued under existing delegation (no board agenda required).
- Staff Data Scientist — 0.9% with accelerated refresh clause; falls within delegate threshold but recommend batch note due to market comp.
- Principal Infra — 1.8% target up-front (near the delegation cap). This one should be queued for board sign-off to avoid manual exceptions.

I attached a short note in the Drive (link in thread) with the delegation thresholds and the proposed batch name: "Q4-2026 Hiring Batch C". If we use that batch for the principal infra hire we should also include a single-line justification in the board packet.

On the 409A: the attached summary is current but Emily — can you confirm whether we should take a new valuation snapshot if we plan to finalize the offer after the board date? If not, we risk differing grant prices.

I'll prepare the cap table extract and a one-pager; Markus, can you pull the last three dilution scenarios into a single slide? I can craft the justification bullet.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Emily Chen <emily.chen@harborlaw.com>, Board Secretary <boardsec@redwood-board.org>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coordinating equity settlement sprint + approval slots for upcoming offers

All —

BoardSec, attaching the draft board slot request (board_slot_request_draft.docx) to formally ask for a 15-minute paper sign slot this Friday (12/03) between 9:00–11:00 PT. If Friday is tight, Thursday afternoon also works.

Emily — if the principal infra hire requires a signed board resolution (given the size), can you confirm the minimum packet we need to circulate (I think: one-pager, cap extract, proposed grant agreement, and the 409A memo). If there's anything else auditors want in advance, flag it.

Marissa — pro rata list looks good. Two notes:
- Please make sure the offer letters reference the pending board slot for the principal infra hire and include the grant as "subject to board approval" language.
- If we want to preserve candidate momentum, consider offering the cash comp + start date while making the equity contingent for up to 14 days post-signature.

I'll finalize the three-slide packet and upload to the Drive link. Laura — once you confirm the batch name I'll lock the cap extract.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Finance Ops (Equity Administration)
Redwood Inference
